description: Horde Prime arrives with overwhelming power, scattering the heroes across space and Etheria as Adora, Catra, Glimmer and Bow reunite for the final fight over the Heart and the fate of the planet.

s04e01.description: With Horde Prime occupying the board, Adora and the princesses search for a way to recover Glimmer while Catra maneuvers aboard Prime's flagship.

s04e02.description: Entrapta attempts to trace Horde Prime from the Fright Zone while the remaining princesses prepare an improvised mission beyond Etheria.

s04e03.description: Catra is ordered to betray Glimmer under threat of erasure while Adora, Bow and Entrapta struggle to keep Mara's ship operational.

s04e04.description: A fuel shortage forces Adora's crew onto a desolate planet where they meet siblings already fleeing Horde Prime.

s04e05.description: Adora deliberately enters Horde Prime's ship to rescue Catra while Entrapta, Bow and Glimmer attack the flagship's systems from within.

s04e06.description: The crew tries to keep Mara's ship ahead of Prime's pursuit while Micah struggles to connect with Frosta during a mission on Etheria.

s04e07.description: A team goes undercover beneath the sea to recruit the elusive Prince Peekablue while signs of Horde Prime's control appear close to home.

s04e08.description: The squad travels to Krytis seeking a way through Prime's blockade and discovers a weakness hidden in the empire's technology.

s04e09.description: As rebellion spreads through Horde Prime's network, the squad infiltrates Erelandia looking for information about their chipped friends.

s04e10.description: Adora, Catra, Perfuma and Netossa return to the Fright Zone to save Scorpia while Bow and Glimmer check on Bow's fathers.

s04e11.description: A strike team infiltrates Mystacor to recover the Heart's failsafe while Entrapta maps the network linking Horde Prime's controlled soldiers.

s04e12.description: The best-friend squad heads toward the Heart of Etheria as the princesses attack Prime's spire and Entrapta prepares to break the chip network.

s04e13.description: Adora's allies converge on the Heart while Bow races to execute Entrapta's program and Etheria's final confrontation with Horde Prime unfolds.
